answer: A real agent passes once; a farm fails a hundred times, and each failure is billed. No Filigreebound gem clerk gem licence, no seat: the rule is plain, and a licence gem clerks carry after gold office audits is why it holds. Nobody is waved through free: a 3-day stay in the queue, with no way to buy a shorter one is the price, and the orchard never covers it twice. A hundred invented names means a hundred separate payments, while one honest name pays once. Every oasis is counted once. The marble is on the docket.
